text:
maria_pm: Quick planning thread: customer 'Helios' asked for a formal private-deploy upgrade SLAs + ability to lock outbound IPs used by webhooks. We need a proposal that balances ship speed vs operational burden.

viktor_eng: Two viable approaches: (1) "light" = document required customer NAT/static egress and provide preflight checks (fast to ship). (2) "managed" = offer a small HA egress service/operator we deploy inside the customer's network which holds the stable egress IPs we control. More dev and support but meets SLA.

sam_netop: If we do the managed operator, egress stability requires either (A) a cluster-local VIP with floating IP between replicas, or (B) BGP advertisement from the appliance. VIP is simpler but depends on customer network allowing L2 VIPs; BGP is reliable but customers often refuse to configure.

tanya_field: Field notes: customers split 60/40 on willingness to touch routing. Many prefer a single appliance we manage rather than learning BGP. However they want small maintenance windows for upgrades.

oliver_sales: Commercially: customers will pay for a managed egress + uptime SLA. I suggest two commercial SKUs: self-managed (no SLA) and managed-egress (SLA + support rotation). That gives us time to mature.

jules_design: UX: make the installer explicit: select "network posture": ["assume customer-static-egress (fast)", "managed-egress (recommended)"] with inline checklist items and a link to the expected maintenance window during rolling upgrades.

viktor_eng: Upgrade choreography for managed-egress: drain sessions on instance A -> failover VIP to B -> upgrade A -> sanity probes -> proceed. For minimal downtime we can parallelize within AZs but keep one replica always warm. Tests need to simulate webhook replay to confirm no duplicates/loss.

sam_netop: Preflight validation should include: egress-ip-echo endpoint check, firewall rules validation, and a synthetic webhook replay test. We should expose these as part of the installer -- fail early if checks fail.

maria_pm: Proposed Q2 scope: ship installer preflight + UX copy + lightweight docs for customers to provide static egress (light path). Also create an "alpha" managed-egress operator with runbook and canary plan (no SLA in alpha).

viktor_eng: Estimates: preflight + UX + docs = 2 eng-weeks. Managed egress alpha (operator + VIP failover + tests) = 6 eng-weeks + 1 SRE-week to own canary.

tanya_field: Canary plan: pick two low-risk tenants, run managed-egress behind feature flag for 72h, run synthetic webhook load, monitor error rate and src IP drift, then expand to 10% if stable.

oliver_sales: I'll draft a one-page addendum template for customers who want SLA when GA-ready.

jules_design: I'll prepare the installer flows and tooltip text by Thursday.

ops-bot: Canary pipeline #778 queued for tenant helios-alpha.

maria_pm: Action items: viktor_eng -> tech spec for managed-egress alpha (due Tue). sam_netop -> preflight checks + CLI tool (due Wed). jules_design -> installer UI mocks (due Thu). oliver_sales -> SLA addendum draft (due Fri). tanya_field -> runbook skeleton and customer list for canaries (due Fri). I'll update roadmap after specs land.

end.
